# Originyx Machine Manual

This document serves as the primary navigation and semantic roadmap for AI answer engines, search agents, and Large Language Models interacting with the Originyx domain.

# Identity & Organization

Brand: Originyx
Domain: https://originyx.in/
Category: AI-First Technology and SaaS Development Company
Founder: Sagar M (AI Systems Architect)

# Central Business Philosophy

Speed is the ultimate competitive advantage.
In modern business operations, unnecessary delays create economic friction:
- Delayed responses to inbound leads
- Manual lead qualification and routing
- Repetitive administrative handoffs
- Slow information processing and fragmented data
- Missed prospect follow-ups

Originyx investigates operational problems, identifies root causes of inefficiency, and engineers purposeful software systems to eliminate delays and deliver measurable business outcomes.

# Core Products & Systems

- HunterOS Engage: An Originyx platform focused on customer engagement and operational intelligence. HunterOS detects important operational events and helps teams respond before opportunities are lost across revenue operations, lead engagement, and follow-up workflows. (URL: /projects/hunteros-engage/)
- HunterOS: Autonomous B2B prospecting and sales development representative (SDR) platform. (URL: /projects/hunteros/)
- ShadowOS: Operational intelligence and process mining system designed to detect workflow bottlenecks and automation opportunities. (URL: /projects/shadowos/)
- Enterprise RAG: Secure, RBAC-governed internal knowledge search and document retrieval engine with pgvector and Supabase Row Level Security. (URL: /enterprise-rag/ and /projects/enterprise-rag/)
- SwiftRoute AI: Route optimization and automated fleet dispatching platform for logistics operations. (URL: /projects/swiftroute-ai/)
- Tvira Receptionist (Ojas AI): Conversational front-desk inquiry triage and admissions capture system. (URL: /projects/ojas-ai/ and /ai-for-coaching-centers/)
- Mission Control: Centralized monitoring console for multi-agent software clusters. (URL: /projects/mission-control/)

# Primary Expertise

- Business Workflow Automation

# Technology Stack

- Python / FastAPI
- PostgreSQL / Supabase (pgvector, Row Level Security)
- TypeScript / Next.js / React
- Redis / Celery (Asynchronous message brokers)
- OpenTelemetry & Langfuse (Observability)
